ledger_title: Creating a National Women's Business Enterprise Policy and prescribing arrangements for developing, coordinating and implementing a national program for women's business enterprise
review_problems: Bridge corrected. The producer's bridge (49 CFR 23 authority line kept "continues to read" by DOT 2026-09-25) is weak: the same rule removes every sex-based presumption, so Part 23 no longer shows any operation of sec. 1-101(c) beyond a credit line (EO 12282 lesson). A stronger live bridge exists that the producer missed: current 40 CFR part 33 (EPA DBE rule, eCFR 2026-10-14) cites E.O. 12138 in its authority and requires financial-assistance recipients to make good-faith efforts for women's business enterprises (WBE definition, 33.202 women deemed disadvantaged) - exactly the 1-101(c) command. 2025-26 orders (EO 14151, 14173, 14236) do not name 12138 (my FR presidential search); 1-101 is limited to what is "permitted by law", so no irreconcilable conflict on the whole order (CR-7). The Interagency Committee (1-2) has a statutory successor (15 U.S.C. 7101, 1994); not needed for yes.
what_remains_inferential: Whether 2025 anti-preference orders conflict irreconcilably with 1-101(b)/(c) is a legal question not resolved; DOT's 2026 rule shows the agency still relies on the order.
